title: HSBall 솔로 #127 · 아마조네스 · Indian Mughal miniature gold-work · 맥주통 쇠공 등에 지기(옆모습)
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Egyptian woman in her late 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm golden-bronze skin, sharp winged kohl liner, a deep terracotta-red lip, a hint of despair, her eyes softly worried and shining, her brow lightly drawn together, low bun hair, real living eyes. Long almond nails, chrome finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Indian Mughal miniature gold-work — a deep midnight-blue ground with fine gold linework and medallions, wide gold-and-crimson bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense jewel-toned scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her body below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line. The paint has worn thin in broad patches over her upper back, hips and calves and chipped off in small flakes at her wrists and ankles, the living skin showing through the faded pattern. Soot smudges her brow, upper lip and cheeks, sweat runs in clean tracks through the grime on her face, black streaks cross her arms and legs, and her bare feet are filthy with dust and dirt.

Restraints: A huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a beer keg rides on her back, held by two thick chains of massive black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, that loop over her shoulders and run down her back to the ball, the chains pulled taut by its weight. Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of the same links, her hands hanging low in front of her hips. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of the same links.

Pose: walking slowly, her body turned in profile to the camera and her face turned toward the camera, bent far forward under the weight of the iron ball on her back, her bare feet flat on the flagstones, her whole body straining with fatigue, her chest, shoulders and stomach in view.

Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, the soles, toes and tops of her feet streaked with soot and dirt.

Background & Lighting: the dim light catching the painted pattern in sharp glints, carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
